agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Management listing directly matches the institution name, Greater Noida city, and Uttar Pradesh state.

The managed proxy returned curl error 60 with the exact self-signed certificate-chain message on initial HTTPS requests; after confirming the expected official hosts, public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

The official Programs/Sitemap pages enumerate four residential PGDM tracks, the FPM and EFPM doctoral programmes, and PGDM Online. The official online subdomain exposes the General Management and Dual Specialisation PGDM tracks. The current Executive Education open-program page exposes the in-date Carbon Credits & Carbon Markets certificate programme; historical MDP tables, news/events, and a commented-out certificate block were excluded.
